stem_book: A 3 kg block on a rough horizontal table (μs = 0.60, μk = 0.45; wood on brick) is pulled by a force that ramps linearly from 0 to 30 N in 5 s. When does it start moving? (g = 9.8 m/s²) (a) At 2.9 s; N = mg and F = μsN decide onset. (b) Never; μs increases with time. (c) At 1.5 s; sliding starts earlier than limiting friction. (d) At 5.0 s by definition of ramp end.
key: a At 2.9 s; N = mg and F = μ s N decide the onset
reason: g = 9.8 m/s² added (with g = 10 the onset is 3.0 s).
